dialogues.jp:
時間は、始業開始の２０分前。走る必要などま
るでない。
dialogues.en: "Bananas are not a staple food though."
dialogues.text: "Bananas are not a staple food though."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「毎日このくらいの時間に登校できると、私は
　嬉しいんだけどね」
dialogues.en:
"Miharu, can't you say my name right? It doesn't sound like
you're talking to me. You've never called me that before..."
dialogues.text:
"Miharu, can't you say my name right? It doesn't sound like
you're talking to me. You've never called me that before..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「美味しい物は、時々食うからいいんだぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"Never mind. If you wan't to call me Nyamu, that's fine.
Anyway, I can't, I'm not free today. Sorry."
dialogues.text:
"Never mind. If you wan't to call me Nyamu, that's fine.
Anyway, I can't, I'm not free today. Sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そういうことじゃないでしょうが」
dialogues.en: "Ask me again some other time, will you?"
dialogues.text: "Ask me again some other time, will you?"

dialogues.jp: 少し、道の流れに人が増えてきた。
dialogues.en: Nemu winked at her.
dialogues.text: Nemu winked at her.

dialogues.jp:
この時間は、島の西側――つまり、市営住宅の
連中が乗るバスが到着する時間帯だ。
dialogues.en: "Do I have a choice? Never mind. Let's go."
dialogues.text: "Do I have a choice? Never mind. Let's go."

dialogues.jp: 「美春がそろそろ来るな」
dialogues.en: To me, two or three don't matter. It's still a crowd.
dialogues.text: To me, two or three don't matter. It's still a crowd.

dialogues.jp: 早く登校している時は、大抵美春に出会う。
dialogues.en: ---- After school.
dialogues.text: ---- After school.

dialogues.jp:
大抵、背後から『おはようございま〜す』と、
相変わらず｛・・・／わんこ｝のように、はしゃぎながらやっ
てくるのだろう。
dialogues.en: Miharu impatiently stamped her foot.
dialogues.text: Miharu impatiently stamped her foot.

dialogues.jp:
朝からあの元気な声を聞くと、こちらが………
疲れる。
dialogues.en: "Late? It's only 5 minutes after class ended!"
dialogues.text: "Late? It's only 5 minutes after class ended!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうかな。あの子は時々大遅刻をするから」
dialogues.en: "The bananas might be gone within 5 minutes, you know?"
dialogues.text: "The bananas might be gone within 5 minutes, you know?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「せっかく俺が早く来ているというのにな……」
dialogues.en: "No, they won't. It's only bananas we're talking about!"
dialogues.text: "No, they won't. It's only bananas we're talking about!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さん、いつからそんなに美春にご執心にな
　られたの？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, no, no, no. You can't belittle bananas. Bananas are..."
dialogues.text: "Oh, no, no, no. You can't belittle bananas. Bananas are..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、別にそんなに会いたいって訳じゃ……」
dialogues.en:
Sitting in the chair, Miharu raised her finger and started
to talk.
dialogues.text:
Sitting in the chair, Miharu raised her finger and started
to talk.

dialogues.jp:
特に他意のない言葉だったが、音夢様はご立腹
のご様子。
dialogues.en: Oh, no. Miharu's banana mode is on.
dialogues.text: Oh, no. Miharu's banana mode is on.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そんなに会いたければ、毎日、早起きすれば
　いいじゃない」
dialogues.en:
"Bananas are good for our heath because they have lots of
potassium, vitamin B6. And they are easy to digest and
generate energy within our body. If you play sports..."
dialogues.text:
"Bananas are good for our heath because they have lots of
potassium, vitamin B6. And they are easy to digest and
generate energy within our body. If you play sports..."

dialogues.jp:
――と、肩にぽんと手が置かれる。ようやく、
美春のご登場か。
dialogues.en:
"You've told me that 100 times before, and you've got a
pretty selective memory for that kind of stuff."
dialogues.text:
"You've told me that 100 times before, and you've got a
pretty selective memory for that kind of stuff."

dialogues.en:
"Tell me about it. We should hurry, or the chocolate bananas
will be gone."
dialogues.text:
"Tell me about it. We should hurry, or the chocolate bananas
will be gone."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おはよう、朝倉兄妹」
dialogues.en: "Ahh! We better hurry!"
dialogues.text: "Ahh! We better hurry!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en:
Suddenly, Miharu stood up, grabbed my hand and opened the
door...
dialogues.text:
Suddenly, Miharu stood up, grabbed my hand and opened the
door...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「音夢、美春はいつのまにか、こんなに大きく
　なってしまったんだなぁ。ヒゲも少し伸ばし
　て立派になって」
dialogues.en: And ran down the hallway,
dialogues.text: And ran down the hallway,

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何の話だ？」
dialogues.en: And out of the school gate...
dialogues.text: And out of the school gate...

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「朝から人が悪いですよ、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Hey, hey, hey... Wait!! Slow down!!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, hey, hey... Wait!! Slow down!!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「冗談だよ」
dialogues.en: "No! The bananas are waiting for me! We've got to run!"
dialogues.text: "No! The bananas are waiting for me! We've got to run!"

dialogues.jp:
音夢の注意に手を振りつつ、それを杉並の挨拶
にもする。
dialogues.en:
Does she always bring out such incredible power when it
comes to bananas?
dialogues.text:
Does she always bring out such incredible power when it
comes to bananas?

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「なんだか、ようやく人並みに扱われた気がす
　るな。それにしても珍しいじゃないか。この
　時間に登校するなんて」
dialogues.en: The view is changing too fast...
dialogues.text: The view is changing too fast...

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ええ、兄さんが｛・・・／珍しく｝早起きをしたので」
dialogues.en: I'm moving so fast...spinning around...
dialogues.text: I'm moving so fast...spinning around...

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「へいへい」
dialogues.en: "Woahhhh...!"
dialogues.text: "Woahhhh...!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ところで杉並くん、美春を見かけませんでし
　たか？」
dialogues.en: "Sempai--, we're almost there."
dialogues.text: "Sempai--, we're almost there."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春？　――ああ、例の｛・・・／わんこ｝。いや、今日
　は見てないな。確かに一緒になることは多い
　が」
dialogues.en:
Miharu's movement was too fast to follow. When I came to my
senses, I found myself standing in the middle of Sakura
Park.
dialogues.text:
Miharu's movement was too fast to follow. When I came to my
senses, I found myself standing in the middle of Sakura
Park.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「なんだ、やっぱ遅刻か。せっかく音夢も早く
　登校してきたっていうのに」
dialogues.en: "Sempai, we got here. It's time for chocolate banana."
dialogues.text: "Sempai, we got here. It's time for chocolate banana."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「私を、兄さんと一緒にしないでください」
dialogues.en: "Haha... What the heck keeps you going like that?"
dialogues.text: "Haha... What the heck keeps you going like that?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ま、いいけどな……」
dialogues.en: "Bananas, of course! I'd do anything for them."
dialogues.text: "Bananas, of course! I'd do anything for them."

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく、ここまで粘ったのだから美春の顔
が見たかったが、仕方の無いことだろう。
dialogues.en: It'd be greater if you could use that power for world peace.
dialogues.text: It'd be greater if you could use that power for world peace.

dialogues.jp: 「しゃあない、もう行くか」
dialogues.en: "Now, let's go get bananas."
dialogues.text: "Now, let's go get bananas."

dialogues.jp:
適当に、その辺を歩いていたクラスメートをつ
かまえて杉並や音夢と一緒に校門をくぐる。
dialogues.en: As Miharu pulled my hand, we walked to the shop.
dialogues.text: As Miharu pulled my hand, we walked to the shop.

dialogues.jp:
――なんとなく、もう少し早起きする回数を増
やそうかなとも思った。
dialogues.en: "You're eating three?"
dialogues.text: "You're eating three?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「やけに騒がしいな」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. Three bananas aren't going to upset my stomach. I
can't really brag about being a banana lover if I don't eat
that much."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. Three bananas aren't going to upset my stomach. I
can't really brag about being a banana lover if I don't eat
that much."

dialogues.jp:
ちょうど、２年の教室がある階を横切るときだっ
た。
dialogues.en: Miharu boastfully puffed out her chest.
dialogues.text: Miharu boastfully puffed out her chest.

dialogues.jp:
どこぞの２年のクラスが妙にざわついていた。
どうも、他のクラスの連中まで集まっているみ
たいだが。
dialogues.en:
"I'll have one with chocolate on it, and I'll pay for both
of us."
dialogues.text:
"I'll have one with chocolate on it, and I'll pay for both
of us."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「何かあったんですかね」
dialogues.en: "Oh, no. You don't have to."
dialogues.text: "Oh, no. You don't have to."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「行ってみるか？」
dialogues.en: "That's okay. It's on me."
dialogues.text: "That's okay. It's on me."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、野次馬はカッコ悪いですよ」
dialogues.en:
She's being so cute that it makes me want to buy something
for her.
dialogues.text:
She's being so cute that it makes me want to buy something
for her.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「なにか面白い事件だったらどうする？」
dialogues.en:
"I kind of feel bad because I was the one that dragged you
here... But thank you, sempai."
dialogues.text:
"I kind of feel bad because I was the one that dragged you
here... But thank you, sempai."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「始業に遅れたら、どうするんですか」
dialogues.en: Miharu bowed deeply. It made me feel a bit embarrassed.
dialogues.text: Miharu bowed deeply. It made me feel a bit embarrassed.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「まだ大丈夫だよ」
dialogues.en:
"Thanks a lot for that. You know, I really like you,
Asakura-sempai."
dialogues.text:
"Thanks a lot for that. You know, I really like you,
Asakura-sempai."

dialogues.jp:
せっかく早く登校して、せっかく騒ぎに遭遇し
たのだ。かったるいとか言ってる場合ではない。
dialogues.en: "Okay... Wow! But I don't know how to respond..."
dialogues.text: "Okay... Wow! But I don't know how to respond..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ヒマ人め。俺は先にあがってるぞ」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おう、じゃあな」
dialogues.en: "Oh... Never mind..."
dialogues.text: "Oh... Never mind..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は杉並に向けて軽く手を振り、騒ぎの方へ向
かった。
dialogues.en:
Sitting on the bench, Miharu and I enjoyed eating chocolate
bananas.
dialogues.text:
Sitting on the bench, Miharu and I enjoyed eating chocolate
bananas.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと兄さん！　あ、杉並くん……私は兄
　さんのほうへついていきます」
dialogues.en:
Miharu finished all three of hers even before I was done
with mine.
dialogues.text:
Miharu finished all three of hers even before I was done
with mine.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、わかった。しかし、大変だな」
dialogues.en: It was really fast.
dialogues.text: It was really fast.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「どうした？　何があったんだ？」
dialogues.en: "That was some tasty stuff, huh?"
dialogues.text: "That was some tasty stuff, huh?"

dialogues.jp: 教室の前でざわざわ騒いでいる２年生に｛たず／訊｝ねる。
dialogues.en: "Yeah, it was really good."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, it was really good."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「いや、ここのクラスの誰かが、事故に遭った
　とかで……」
dialogues.en:
Chocolate and banana are not always compatible tastes, but
this was perfect.
dialogues.text:
Chocolate and banana are not always compatible tastes, but
this was perfect.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "I think bananas are... Hmm?"
dialogues.text: "I think bananas are... Hmm?"

dialogues.jp: 物騒な単語に思わず眉をしかめる。
dialogues.en:
As she was talking cheerfully, Miharu suddenly dropped her
shoulders.
dialogues.text:
As she was talking cheerfully, Miharu suddenly dropped her
shoulders.

dialogues.jp:
物見遊山で来てしまったが、どうやら音夢の意
見が正しかったようだ。
dialogues.en: "Hmm? What happened?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm? What happened?"

dialogues.jp: 「それで大丈夫だったのか？」
dialogues.en:
As she turned around to my side, Miharu was slowly falling
down on me.
dialogues.text:
As she turned around to my side, Miharu was slowly falling
down on me.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「さあ、詳しくは……何かを取ろうとして事故
　に遭ったとかなんとか――」
dialogues.en: "S-Sorry... Sempai..."
dialogues.text: "S-Sorry... Sempai..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「違うって。何かを助けようとしたんだって」
dialogues.en: "What happened?"
dialogues.text: "What happened?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en:
"Ah... my power spring seems to have stopped working because
I ran too fast."
dialogues.text:
"Ah... my power spring seems to have stopped working because
I ran too fast."

dialogues.jp: 周囲から別の意見がわいて出る。
dialogues.en: "Power spring...?"
dialogues.text: "Power spring...?"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「１０階建てのビルの屋上にのぼった子供らし
　いぞ」
dialogues.en: I remembeed that she had a wind-up energy source inside.
dialogues.text: I remembeed that she had a wind-up energy source inside.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「え、じゃあ、自殺を助けようとして？」
dialogues.en:
"Can you wind the spring for me? Otherwise, I will stop
eventually."
dialogues.text:
"Can you wind the spring for me? Otherwise, I will stop
eventually."

dialogues.speaker: Female Student
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、落ちてきた子供の下敷きになって？」
dialogues.en: "How do I wind it here...?"
dialogues.text: "How do I wind it here...?"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「その時は無事だったけど、その後、車にはね
　られたんじゃないのか？」
dialogues.en: I can't wind it unless Miharu opens her back.
dialogues.text: I can't wind it unless Miharu opens her back.

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「車は、２００キロ出してた白のポルシェって
　ホント？」
dialogues.en: People can see us around here...
dialogues.text: People can see us around here...

dialogues.speaker: Female Student
dialogues.jp:
「子供じゃなくて、木登りが得意なサルって聞
　いたわ」
dialogues.en: "Would you want to come to my place? It's safe."
dialogues.text: "Would you want to come to my place? It's safe."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……兄さん、何かあったの？」
dialogues.en: "Okay... Sorry, sempai."
dialogues.text: "Okay... Sorry, sempai."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……よくはわからんのだが」
dialogues.en: Miharu can still walk, but slowly.
dialogues.text: Miharu can still walk, but slowly.

dialogues.jp: 今までの話題を少し頭でまとめてみる。
dialogues.en:
Miharu said her spring never runs down this fast. It seems
she got a little carried away today.
dialogues.text:
Miharu said her spring never runs down this fast. It seems
she got a little carried away today.

dialogues.jp:
「子供に見えるくらいの大きさで、木登りの得
　意なサルが、１０匹ほどビルの屋上にのぼっ
　たんだと」
dialogues.en:
I also completely forgot about her spring, and I was
supposed to take care of her.
dialogues.text:
I also completely forgot about her spring, and I was
supposed to take care of her.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ？」
dialogues.en: "Come on then."
dialogues.text: "Come on then."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「でもって、次々と自殺を図ったらしいんだが、
　それをうちの学生が下で受け止めて助けたと」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「その後で、道路を時速２００キロで走りなが
　ら白いポルシェとのガチンコ勝負に負けて、
　意識不明の重体らしい」
dialogues.en:
Nemu isn't home yet, which is unusual at this time. But it's
better she is not here now.
dialogues.text:
Nemu isn't home yet, which is unusual at this time. But it's
better she is not here now.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「――うん。以上だ」
dialogues.en: It's good she's busy with her own life.
dialogues.text: It's good she's busy with her own life.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うちの学生は、Ｍ７８星雲からでも来たんで
　すか？」
dialogues.en:
"Wow... This is the first time I've ever been to your room,
sempai."
dialogues.text:
"Wow... This is the first time I've ever been to your room,
sempai."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Yeah... You're right."
dialogues.text: "Yeah... You're right."

dialogues.jp: やっぱ、変か。
dialogues.en:
Miharu has come to our house before, but she was coming to
see Nemu.
dialogues.text:
Miharu has come to our house before, but she was coming to
see Nemu.

dialogues.jp:
自分で言うのも何だがこの話はどうもおかしい。
おかしすぎる。
dialogues.en:
In fact, for this Miharu, this is the first time she's come
to my house.
dialogues.text:
In fact, for this Miharu, this is the first time she's come
to my house.

dialogues.jp:
こういう話には、尾ヒレ背ビレがつくというが、
ヒレだらけで、しかも材質も種類も不明っぽい。
dialogues.en: "Let me wind the spring for you."
dialogues.text: "Let me wind the spring for you."

dialogues.jp:
「このままにしておくと気持ち悪いし、ちょっ
　と確認してみよう、音夢」
dialogues.en: "Hey... Don't show your back like that, will you?"
dialogues.text: "Hey... Don't show your back like that, will you?"

dialogues.jp:
ちょうど美春のクラスのようだから、音夢を連
れていけば問題あるまい。
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.jp:
廊下もだったが、教室の中にも人が多く、何や
らごちゃごちゃと会話が飛び交っている。
dialogues.en: Gosh... Her moaning like that excites me.
dialogues.text: Gosh... Her moaning like that excites me.

dialogues.speaker: Female Student
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉先輩！　美春が……」
dialogues.en:
I got the key from Miharu and put it into the hole on her
back.
dialogues.text:
I got the key from Miharu and put it into the hole on her
back.

dialogues.speaker: Female Student
dialogues.jp: 「ん、あぁ、美春の友達の……」
dialogues.en:
I remember Miharu has kept this key for a long time, but I
don't remember what it was originally for. She said it was
something important.
dialogues.text:
I remember Miharu has kept this key for a long time, but I
don't remember what it was originally for. She said it was
something important.

dialogues.jp: 名前なんだっけ？
dialogues.en:
I should tell her not to moan like that. But she said
winding the spring gives her a strange feeling.
dialogues.text:
I should tell her not to moan like that. But she said
winding the spring gives her a strange feeling.

dialogues.jp: 「ん、え、美春？」
dialogues.en: Wind... Wind...
dialogues.text: Wind... Wind...

dialogues.jp:
女の子の名前を考えようとして、ふと、その前
の台詞にひっかかる。
dialogues.en: "Hey, stop moaning like that."
dialogues.text: "Hey, stop moaning like that."

dialogues.speaker: さっちん
dialogues.jp: 「美春が……、美春が……」
dialogues.en: I know it's hard for her not to.
dialogues.text: I know it's hard for her not to.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「さっちん、泣かないで……」
dialogues.en: "Sorry... It's just so difficult not to."
dialogues.text: "Sorry... It's just so difficult not to."

dialogues.jp:
さらにもう一人女の子が出てくると、最初の女
の子は彼女の胸に顔をうずめた。
dialogues.en: Miharu turned around and looked at me with her sensual eyes.
dialogues.text: Miharu turned around and looked at me with her sensual eyes.

dialogues.speaker: 洋子
dialogues.jp: 「あの……美春が、日曜日に桜公園で木に……」
dialogues.en: Knock, knock.
dialogues.text: Knock, knock.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「天枷のやつ、日曜日に桜公園で木に登って降
　りられなくなった猫を助けようとしたらしい
　んですよ」
dialogues.en: "Niisan? Are you there? I'm coming in."
dialogues.text: "Niisan? Are you there? I'm coming in."

dialogues.jp:
泣き出してしまった女の子の代わりに、近くに
いた男子が、苦しげに言葉を吐き出す。
dialogues.en: What...?
dialogues.text: What...?

dialogues.en: The door opens.
dialogues.text: The door opens.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「その……猫は助けたんですけど、その時、木
　から落ちて……その」
dialogues.en: "Niisan, is anyone there with you?"
dialogues.text: "Niisan, is anyone there with you?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お、おい、それから……」
dialogues.en: "Miharu!? What... What are you doing here!?"
dialogues.text: "Miharu!? What... What are you doing here!?"

dialogues.jp:
胸が突然苦しくなった。バクンバクンという音
が頭の中をかけめぐる。
dialogues.en: What Nemu saw was...
dialogues.text: What Nemu saw was...

dialogues.jp: 息は吐けるのに吸うことが出来ない。
dialogues.en: A half naked Miharu.
dialogues.text: A half naked Miharu.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うう……、美春ったら、その時……打ち所が
　悪くて、あの……うう、うくぅ」
dialogues.en: And Nemu must have heard the moaning sound too.
dialogues.text: And Nemu must have heard the moaning sound too.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと待て！　打ち所が悪くて何だって？」
dialogues.en: "N-N-N-Niisan... Ahh..."
dialogues.text: "N-N-N-Niisan... Ahh..."

dialogues.jp: 話が理解できないぞ？
dialogues.en: Suddendly, Nemu's face turned red.
dialogues.text: Suddendly, Nemu's face turned red.

dialogues.jp: 木に登った猫を助けようとして、それで？
dialogues.en: "Um... This isn't what you think it is, Nemu..."
dialogues.text: "Um... This isn't what you think it is, Nemu..."

dialogues.jp: 打ち所が悪いって……。
dialogues.en: Nemu blushed to the point where she was about to explode.
dialogues.text: Nemu blushed to the point where she was about to explode.

dialogues.jp: だから？　だから、何なんだ？
dialogues.en: The door was slammed shut.
dialogues.text: The door was slammed shut.

dialogues.jp: 不意に、俺の視界の中に綺麗な色の花が見えた。
「お、おい……あの花、」

｛・・／誰か｝の机の上に、新しい花を生けた花瓶が飾ら
れていた。
dialogues.en:
We were at the wrong place and at the wrong time. It's all
bad.
dialogues.text:
We were at the wrong place and at the wrong time. It's all
bad.

dialogues.jp: 突然、俺の腕が強い力で握られる。
dialogues.en:
Obviously, Nemu misunderstood the whole thing, which means
she won't talk to me for a while.
dialogues.text:
Obviously, Nemu misunderstood the whole thing, which means
she won't talk to me for a while.

dialogues.en:
If she doesn't talk to me, then our relationship is going to
fall apart...
dialogues.text:
If she doesn't talk to me, then our relationship is going to
fall apart...

dialogues.jp:
何かがしがみついている腕をグイッと引っ張る。
まるで、鉄球でもつけられたかのように重い。
dialogues.en:
"I guess I have no choice but to tell her the truth about
Miharu."
dialogues.text:
"I guess I have no choice but to tell her the truth about
Miharu."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "What? Are you serious?"
dialogues.text: "What? Are you serious?"

dialogues.jp: ――音夢だった。
dialogues.en: "I've got no other choice."
dialogues.text: "I've got no other choice."

dialogues.jp: 「音夢」
dialogues.en: "I don't get it, but if you say so..."
dialogues.text: "I don't get it, but if you say so..."

dialogues.jp: 音夢は身体中をガクガクと震わせていた。
dialogues.en: "Sure..."
dialogues.text: "Sure..."

dialogues.jp:
歯の根も合わぬほど、震えており、目はどこを
見ているのかわからないほどに……。
dialogues.en:
I have no other choice. This way everything should be clear
for Nemu.
dialogues.text:
I have no other choice. This way everything should be clear
for Nemu.

dialogues.jp: 「お、おいっ、しっかりしろっ」
dialogues.en: A million sighs of disappointment won't be enough...
dialogues.text: A million sighs of disappointment won't be enough...

dialogues.jp:
俺が音夢を揺すると、まるで枯れ葉が木から散
るように、ずるずるとその場にへたり込んだ。
dialogues.en: "I'll tell you......"
dialogues.text: "I'll tell you......"

dialogues.jp:
さっきまで俺の腕を強く握っていた力はどこに
もなく、全身がだらりとうなだれていた。
dialogues.en: So I did.
dialogues.text: So I did.

dialogues.jp: 「なぁ、ウソだろ？　美春が……その」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Nemu?"

dialogues.jp:
どうしても、その決定的な言葉を口にすること
ができなかった。
dialogues.en: Nemu doesn't respond.
dialogues.text: Nemu doesn't respond.

dialogues.jp:
それを言ってしまったら、本当だと認めてしま
わなければならない、そんな気がした。
dialogues.en: "Look... Nemu-san...?"
dialogues.text: "Look... Nemu-san...?"

dialogues.jp: ――と、その瞬間。
dialogues.en: Nemu stayed quiet, just watching TV.
dialogues.text: Nemu stayed quiet, just watching TV.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「こんばんわ〜！」
dialogues.en: "Nyamu-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Nyamu-sempai?"

dialogues.jp: 教室にいたほぼ全員の動きがぴたりと止まる。
dialogues.en: "Hey, stop it."
dialogues.text: "Hey, stop it."

dialogues.jp:
そして、一斉に視線が入り口にいる人物に浴び
せかけられた。
dialogues.en: But it's too late. Nemu's neck turns red.
dialogues.text: But it's too late. Nemu's neck turns red.

dialogues.en: "Hey, listen... Nemu."
dialogues.text: "Hey, listen... Nemu."

dialogues.jp: 一番最初に口を開いたのは俺だった。
dialogues.en: Nemu said with her nose in the air.
dialogues.text: Nemu said with her nose in the air.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あれぇ？　えーと、朝倉先輩じゃないですか。
　先輩の教室はここじゃないですよぉ」
dialogues.en:
Why is Nemu so upset after all? A woman's mind is so
complicated.
dialogues.text:
Why is Nemu so upset after all? A woman's mind is so
complicated.

dialogues.jp:
美春はそう言いながら、軽い足取りで教室の中
に入ってくる。
dialogues.en:
"Listen. This Miharu is not the real Miharu. She is a
robot."
dialogues.text:
"Listen. This Miharu is not the real Miharu. She is a
robot."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……ぐすっ、美春？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「うわわ、洋子ったら何で泣いてるの？」
dialogues.en: Nemu sounded totally surprised.
dialogues.text: Nemu sounded totally surprised.

dialogues.speaker: 洋子
dialogues.jp: 「……洋子はあたし。そっちはさっちん」
dialogues.en: Come to think of it, that line sounds weird, very weird.
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, that line sounds weird, very weird.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうだっけ。あはは、ごめんねぇ」
dialogues.en: "It's true. I'm a robot, sempai."
dialogues.text: "It's true. I'm a robot, sempai."

dialogues.jp: 美春はいつもの調子で笑っている。
dialogues.en: Now Nemu turns away from the TV and looks at us.
dialogues.text: Now Nemu turns away from the TV and looks at us.

dialogues.jp: 一同、呆気にとられていた。
dialogues.en: With an incredibly skeptical look.
dialogues.text: With an incredibly skeptical look.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「優ちゃん、こんばんは」
dialogues.en: "See... I AM A ROBOT. MY NAME IS MIHARU... "
dialogues.text: "See... I AM A ROBOT. MY NAME IS MIHARU... "

dialogues.speaker: 祐理
dialogues.jp:
「わたしは、祐理だって。……それに、今は朝
　だよ？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, you sound like an idiot and it isn't working."
dialogues.text: "Hey, you sound like an idiot and it isn't working."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ん〜……？　あぁ、そっかそっか」
dialogues.en:
"This is all I can do. I'm not equipped with missiles or
laser, you know?"
dialogues.text:
"This is all I can do. I'm not equipped with missiles or
laser, you know?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「明るいのは朝……暗いのは夜……と」
dialogues.en: "Hey, guys......"
dialogues.text: "Hey, guys......"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: Nemu gives us a woeful and pitiful look.
dialogues.text: Nemu gives us a woeful and pitiful look.

dialogues.jp:
メモか何かのように、手の平に指をぐりぐり突
き立てている。
dialogues.en: "No, Nemu. You don't understand. She really is......"
dialogues.text: "No, Nemu. You don't understand. She really is......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「浩子おはよう」
dialogues.en:
"Niisan, even a kids' TV show would make things more
realistic. Nobody would buy that kind of story."
dialogues.text:
"Niisan, even a kids' TV show would make things more
realistic. Nobody would buy that kind of story."

dialogues.speaker: 優
dialogues.jp: 「あたしが優だってば」
dialogues.en: "What I'm saying is..."
dialogues.text: "What I'm saying is..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「モリリン、おはよう」
dialogues.en:
"It would look more persuasive if I had guns on my fingers
or missiles on my knees."
dialogues.text:
"It would look more persuasive if I had guns on my fingers
or missiles on my knees."

dialogues.speaker: 浩子
dialogues.jp: 「あの……私、浩子なんだけど」
dialogues.en:
Miharu's image of robot seems a bit destructive. Does she
want to be like that?
dialogues.text:
Miharu's image of robot seems a bit destructive. Does she
want to be like that?

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あれぇ、おかしいな。ひとつずつデータがず
　れてるみたい……。せっかく、ちゃんと覚え
　てきたのに」
dialogues.en:
"It would also be nice if I could do math real fast. But I
don't have that kind of ability either."
dialogues.text:
"It would also be nice if I could do math real fast. But I
don't have that kind of ability either."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……もしや、事故の後遺症か？」
dialogues.en:
I wish she could have at least that kind of ability as a
robot.
dialogues.text:
I wish she could have at least that kind of ability as a
robot.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はい？　何か言いました？」
dialogues.en:
Nemu slowly sinks into the sofa with a deep sigh of
disappointment.
dialogues.text:
Nemu slowly sinks into the sofa with a deep sigh of
disappointment.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en:
"You guys are giving me a headache now. Please stop the
nonsense. I feel embarrassed to be your sister."
dialogues.text:
"You guys are giving me a headache now. Please stop the
nonsense. I feel embarrassed to be your sister."

dialogues.jp: と、自分の席の花に気が付く美春。

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あれぇ？　綺麗なお花。誰？　これ飾ってく
　れたの」
dialogues.en:
The truth is the truth. How can I get her to understand
this?
dialogues.text:
The truth is the truth. How can I get her to understand
this?

dialogues.speaker: 祐理
dialogues.jp:
「あ、ごめん。飾ったのわたし。あの、すぐど
　けるからね」
dialogues.en:
I feel like a farmer who had contact with aliens, but no one
would believe him.
dialogues.text:
I feel like a farmer who had contact with aliens, but no one
would believe him.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「えー、どうして？　綺麗なのにー」
dialogues.en: "This is true. So please listen."
dialogues.text: "This is true. So please listen."

dialogues.jp:
祐理という名前のクラスメイトは、そう言って
そそくさと花瓶を下げた。
dialogues.en:
With a deep sigh, Nemu pulls herself up and repositions
herself on the sofa.
dialogues.text:
With a deep sigh, Nemu pulls herself up and repositions
herself on the sofa.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……それにしてもみんなどうしたの？　何か、
　ヘンだよ？」
dialogues.en:
"Okay. I'll listen to you. I won't get mad even though it's
a lie. So just tell me now."
dialogues.text:
"Okay. I'll listen to you. I won't get mad even though it's
a lie. So just tell me now."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、もしや！」
dialogues.en:
I know how she feels. But what I'm about to tell her is the
whole truth -- nothing but the truth.
dialogues.text:
I know how she feels. But what I'm about to tell her is the
whole truth -- nothing but the truth.

dialogues.jp: はわわ、と美春が目を見開く。
dialogues.en: I tried my best to make it all simple and understandable.
dialogues.text: I tried my best to make it all simple and understandable.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春がやって来る、ちょうど直前に、お寿司
　もケーキもなくなってしまったんですね？」
dialogues.en:
I told her about the accident Miharu was involved in, that
the real Miharu was still in the hospital, and that the
Miharu here was a robot Miharu.
dialogues.text:
I told her about the accident Miharu was involved in, that
the real Miharu was still in the hospital, and that the
Miharu here was a robot Miharu.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「だから、みんなして、こんなよそよそしくて。
　何て間の悪い奴なんだ、みたいな？」
dialogues.en: "So you want me to believe your story?"
dialogues.text: "So you want me to believe your story?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はあ？」
dialogues.en: Miharu and I nod at the same time.
dialogues.text: Miharu and I nod at the same time.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「え〜ん、美春も食べたかったですよ……」
dialogues.en:
"In a way, your story does make sense. But you're not gonna
tell me later that Miharu just had a wacky idea like that
because of her head injury or something, are you?"
dialogues.text:
"In a way, your story does make sense. But you're not gonna
tell me later that Miharu just had a wacky idea like that
because of her head injury or something, are you?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「おいおい、寿司とかケーキとか、どっから出
　てきたんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"No way! In fact, I was just trying to wind her power spring
in my room."
dialogues.text:
"No way! In fact, I was just trying to wind her power spring
in my room."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……パーティーの定番じゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "Do you want to see it, Nyamu? It's in my back."
dialogues.text: "Do you want to see it, Nyamu? It's in my back."

dialogues.jp: じとっと、見上げてくる。
dialogues.en: Miharu sits next to Nemu and turns her back to her.
dialogues.text: Miharu sits next to Nemu and turns her back to her.

dialogues.jp:
「定番かどうかは知らんが、今ここでパーティー
　なんてやってないぞ？」
dialogues.en:
Then, she undoes her buttons on her uniform and tries to
take it off.
dialogues.text:
Then, she undoes her buttons on her uniform and tries to
take it off.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そうなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Niisan, don't look!"
dialogues.text: "Niisan, don't look!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……よく分からん奴」
dialogues.en:
I have already seen it. But I looked away as Nemu stared at
me hard.
dialogues.text:
I have already seen it. But I looked away as Nemu stared at
me hard.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あのな、美春。みんなが気になってることだ
　ろうから聞くけど――」
dialogues.en: "Right here......?"
dialogues.text: "Right here......?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「お前、事故に遭って、病院に運ばれたんじゃ
　ないのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. Ahh... Don't press it hard... That's a sensitive
part."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. Ahh... Don't press it hard... That's a sensitive
part."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それであんた死んだって……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, s-sorry... I'll be gentle."
dialogues.text: "Oh, s-sorry... I'll be gentle."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ええ！　死んだって誰が！？」

dialogues.speaker: 祐理
dialogues.jp: 「いや、だから美春が」
dialogues.en: ---- Her moaning made the situation pretty erotic.
dialogues.text: ---- Her moaning made the situation pretty erotic.

dialogues.jp: いったいどうなってるんだ？
dialogues.en:
I wonder if Nemu is actually doing some nasty things to
Miharu behind my back.
dialogues.text:
I wonder if Nemu is actually doing some nasty things to
Miharu behind my back.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、えーと……ああ、そうだ！　そう、事故
　に遭って……病院に運ばれて、それで、え〜
　と、美春は元気になりました……と」
dialogues.en: "Niisan, that's enough."
dialogues.text: "Niisan, that's enough."

dialogues.jp:
美春は、まるで百面相のように表情を変えなが
ら、ぶつぶつ言い、最終的にそう答えた。
dialogues.en:
When I turned around, I saw Miharu closing her buttons, and
Nemu looked disappointed.
dialogues.text:
When I turned around, I saw Miharu closing her buttons, and
Nemu looked disappointed.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さん……つまり美春が死んだっていうのは、
　間違いってことでいいの？」
dialogues.en: "Yes... She's not a human."
dialogues.text: "Yes... She's not a human."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうじゃないかな？　多分」
dialogues.en: "But... Where is the real Miharu now?"
dialogues.text: "But... Where is the real Miharu now?"

dialogues.jp:
いまいち状況が掴めないが、実際に本人が生き
て目の前にいるんじゃ、そうであるとしか言い
様がない。
dialogues.en: "Like I said, she's still in the hospital."
dialogues.text: "Like I said, she's still in the hospital."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おーい、天枷死亡説は間違いだってさー！」
dialogues.en: "I thought Miharu had survived, but she's..."
dialogues.text: "I thought Miharu had survived, but she's..."

dialogues.jp:
その声と同時に、辺りからは『なーんだ』とか
『よかったー』とか様々な声が飛び交った。
dialogues.en:
"She's not dead! Everything is going to be just fine, though
we don't know when she will wake up..."
dialogues.text:
"She's not dead! Everything is going to be just fine, though
we don't know when she will wake up..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「総員、撤収ー！」
dialogues.en: "Honestly, I wasn't that shocked to find she was a robot."
dialogues.text: "Honestly, I wasn't that shocked to find she was a robot."

dialogues.jp: 教室がいつもの雰囲気に戻った。
dialogues.en: Miharu sighed sadly.
dialogues.text: Miharu sighed sadly.

dialogues.jp:
当の美春だけは、なんだかやけにニコニコとし
ていたが。
dialogues.en:
Miharu anxiously looked at Nemu. But Nemu still put her head
down and shook it slowly.
dialogues.text:
Miharu anxiously looked at Nemu. But Nemu still put her head
down and shook it slowly.

dialogues.jp: 「ったく、人騒がせなヤツだな」
dialogues.en: Suddenly, Nemu stopped talking.
dialogues.text: Suddenly, Nemu stopped talking.

dialogues.jp:
のほほんと、番茶でも持たせてやりたいくらい
ののほほんぶりである。
dialogues.en: And then ----
dialogues.text: And then ----

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ねぇ、にゃむ先輩」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……誰？　そのにゃむ先輩ってのは……」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あれ？　違いましたっけ！　ええと、ええと、
　そう音夢先輩でした」
dialogues.en: Nemu said, "I want to be alone now", and ran into her room.
dialogues.text: Nemu said, "I want to be alone now", and ran into her room.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……頭の打ち所がおかしかったか？」
dialogues.en: "Uh... Asakura-sempai..."
dialogues.text: "Uh... Asakura-sempai..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「え、ええと、あはは。そうかもしれません」
dialogues.en: "I hope so......"
dialogues.text: "I hope so......"

dialogues.jp: 美春が妙に焦った風にそう言った。
dialogues.en: Miharu gave me a sad look.
dialogues.text: Miharu gave me a sad look.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、チャイムッ！」
dialogues.en: "I'll talk to Nemu again later. You should go home now."
dialogues.text: "I'll talk to Nemu again later. You should go home now."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「や、やばッ！」
dialogues.en:
Miharu looked sad on the way home. By the time we got there,
however, she seemed to have cheered up a bit. She went home
with her usual smile.
dialogues.text:
Miharu looked sad on the way home. By the time we got there,
however, she seemed to have cheered up a bit. She went home
with her usual smile.

dialogues.jp:
俺と音夢はいくつか机にぶつかりながら、急い
で教室を出ていった。
dialogues.en: Should I not have told anyone about Miharu?
dialogues.text: Should I not have told anyone about Miharu?

dialogues.jp:
すでに、ア行の出欠を取り始めている暦先生が
じろりと俺達を｛にら／睨｝んだ。
dialogues.en:
Maybe I should've kept it secret even if Nemu misunderstood
me.
dialogues.text:
Maybe I should've kept it secret even if Nemu misunderstood
me.

dialogues.jp:
俺はまだ慣れているけど、音夢の方は人生最大
の汚点だとばかり、大きなため息を吐きながら
机に座った。
dialogues.en:
When I got home, Nemu was watching TV in the living room as
usual.
dialogues.text:
When I got home, Nemu was watching TV in the living room as
usual.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「――で、今日のＨＲは終わり。朝倉兄はこの
　後、生物準備室に来ること」
dialogues.en: "Hi, niisan."
dialogues.text: "Hi, niisan."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「え、俺？　どうして？」
dialogues.en: "Are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "Are you okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「大事な話があるんだ。今後の人生に関係があ
　るくらい」
dialogues.en: "I'm fine. I was just shocked. But I'm okay now."
dialogues.text: "I'm fine. I was just shocked. But I'm okay now."

dialogues.jp:
そして『じゃ、待ってるよ』と言って、教室を
出ていってしまった。
dialogues.en: "Glad to hear that."
dialogues.text: "Glad to hear that."

dialogues.jp: 途端に教室は開放され、｛にぎ／賑｝やかになる。
dialogues.en:
She seems better than I thought. I would throw up my hands
if she completely shut herself off from me.
dialogues.text:
She seems better than I thought. I would throw up my hands
if she completely shut herself off from me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あんた、何したの？」
dialogues.en: "Sorry that I didn't tell you sooner."
dialogues.text: "Sorry that I didn't tell you sooner."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、何もしてないぞ」
dialogues.en:
"I can understand. You can't tell everyone that sort of
thing."
dialogues.text:
"I can understand. You can't tell everyone that sort of
thing."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「委員長としては放っておけないのよね。ほら
　呼び出し喰らうようなこと、何したの？」
dialogues.en: Nemu smiled.
dialogues.text: Nemu smiled.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「してないってば！」
dialogues.en:
"The real Miharu is doing fine, right? Then there's nothing
to worry about."
dialogues.text:
"The real Miharu is doing fine, right? Then there's nothing
to worry about."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さん、これ以上、朝倉家の顔に泥は塗らな
　いでくださいね……」
dialogues.en:
"No wonder she says my name rather strangely. It all makes
sense now."
dialogues.text:
"No wonder she says my name rather strangely. It all makes
sense now."

dialogues.jp: あー、もうッ、お前まで！
dialogues.en: Well, I kind of like how she says Nemu's name.
dialogues.text: Well, I kind of like how she says Nemu's name.

dialogues.jp: とはいえ、何の呼び出しなんだろう。
dialogues.en: I chuckled too.
dialogues.text: I chuckled too.

dialogues.en: "One thing, Nemu--"
dialogues.text: "One thing, Nemu--"

dialogues.jp: 一抹の不安を抱えつつ、席を立つ。
dialogues.en: Somehow, everything worked out fine.
dialogues.text: Somehow, everything worked out fine.

dialogues.jp: ◆美春が事故◆
dialogues.en: ◆Miharu◆
dialogues.text: ◆Miharu◆

dialogues.jp:
ざわつく２年のクラスに行くと美春が死んだと
聞かされた。木から降りられなくなった猫を助
けようとして、木から落ちて……。
dialogues.en: Miharu caught me on the way to the classroom after lunch.
dialogues.text: Miharu caught me on the way to the classroom after lunch.

dialogues.jp:
教室中が深い悲しみに包まれる中、やけに明る
い声が教室に響いた。
dialogues.en: "Do you have time after school today?"
dialogues.text: "Do you have time after school today?"

dialogues.jp: 声の主は美春だった。
dialogues.en: "Yeah, sure. I do."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, sure. I do."

dialogues.jp:
のほほんと笑う美春。どうやら美春死亡説は間
違いだったらしい。
dialogues.en: "Good! Why don't we go get some chocolate bananas?"
dialogues.text: "Good! Why don't we go get some chocolate bananas?"

dialogues.jp: ったく、ほんと人騒がせなヤツだな。
dialogues.en: "Chocolate bananas? You just ate some yesterday!"
dialogues.text: "Chocolate bananas? You just ate some yesterday!"
